'''Gudrun Kalmbach''' (27 May 1937 – 25 July 2025) was a German mathematician and educator known for her contributions in the field of [[quantum logic]] and for the educational programmes she developed.

== Life and career ==
After teacher training in mathematics and chemistry, Kalmbach obtained a PhD at the [[University of Göttingen]] under the supervision of [[Hans Grauert]] on the topic of [[Low-dimensional topology|low-dimensional]] [[CW complex]]es in non-[[Compact space|compact]] [[manifold]]s.<ref>{{cite book |editor-first1=Ingrid|editor-last1=Bauer|editor-first2=Fabrizio|editor-last2=Catanese|editor-first3=Yujiro|editor-last3=Kawamata|editor-first4=Thomas|editor-last4=Peternell|editor-first5=Yum-Tong|editor-last5=Siu|title=Complex Geometry: Collection of Papers{{snd}}Dedicated to Hans Grauert|publisher=Springer |year=2002|page=XII |isbn=978-3-642-56202-0}}</ref> 

From 1967 to 1969, Kalmbach taught at the [[University of Illinois at Urbana–Champaign]]. After this she held positions as assistant professor at the [[University of Massachusetts Amherst]] (1970–1971) and [[Pennsylvania State University]] (1969–1975). In 1975, she qualified as professor at the [[University of Ulm]], becoming the first female professor in [[geometry]] (at the chair of [[number theory]] and [[probability theory]]).<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.augsburger-allgemeine.de/neu-ulm/Mehr-Frauen-in-die-Spitzenforschung-id4323746.html|title=Mehr Frauen in die Spitzenforschung|last=Schröck|first=Martina|website=Augsburger Allgemeine|language=de|access-date=15 February 2019}}</ref> She worked there until her retirement in 2002.

Kalmbach's research focused on [[manifold]]s, [[lattice theory]] and quantum structures.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.tib.eu/de/suchen/id/TIBKAT:253279739/Quantum-structures-II-dedicated-to-Gudrun-Kalmbach/|title=Quantum structures II dedicated to Gudrun Kalmbach by the - Technische Informationsbibliothek (TIB)|website=www.tib.eu|language=de|access-date=5 March 2019}}</ref>

In addition to her research career, Kalmbach invented in 1985 the talent program in [[Science, technology, engineering, and mathematics|STEM]] subjects (called MINT in Germany).<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://mint-wigris.bplaced.net/|title=MINT-WIGRIS Startseite|website=mint-wigris.bplaced.net|access-date=15 February 2019}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|last=Kalmbach (et al. ed.)|first=Gudrun|title=MINT (Mathematik, Informatik, Naturwissenschaften, Technik), Volume 1-40|publisher=MINT Verlag|location=Bad Wörishofen|year=2019}}</ref> Part of this is the yearly mathematics competition at the University of Ulm.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://mint-wigris.bplaced.net/ueberblick-zu-den-durchgefuehrten-wettbewerben.html|title=Tag der Mathematik - Universität Ulm|website=www.uni-ulm.de|access-date=15 February 2019}}</ref> From this, pupils were selected to attend a mathematics summer school with teaching in computer science, chemistry, physics and where they were introduced to university mathematics.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://mint-wigris.bplaced.net/kursinhalte-1985-bis-2001.html|title=Kursinhalte 1985 bis 2001|website=mint-wigris.bplaced.net|access-date=15 February 2019}}</ref>

She was a founder of [[European Women in Mathematics]],<ref>{{citation|url=http://www-history.mcs.st-andrews.ac.uk/Societies/European_Women.html|title=European Women in Mathematics|date=February 2018|website=[[MacTutor History of Mathematics archive]]|access-date=28 September 2019}}</ref> and a member and chair of the [[Emmy Noether]] Verein which supports female mathematicians.<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=wMdsAAAAIAAJ&q=Emmy+Noether+Verein,+kalmbach|title=Internationale mathematische Nachrichten|date=1994|pages=6|language=de}}</ref>

Kalmbach last lived in Bad Wörishofen,<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.augsburger-allgemeine.de/mindelheim/Verstecktes-Talent-geehrt-id6822216.html|title="Verstecktes Talent" geehrt|last=Issing|first=Franz|website=Augsburger Allgemeine|language=de|access-date=15 February 2019}}</ref> where she died on 25 July 2025, at the age of 88.<ref>[https://trauer.sueddeutsche.de/traueranzeige/gudrun-kalmbach "Gudrun Kalmbach"] (death notice). sueddeutsche.de, 9 August 2025 (in German). Retrieved 9 August 2025.</ref>
